in_marathi.name: Ekagraansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekagraansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ekagra’ meaning ‘one-pointed’ and ‘Ansh’ meaning ‘manifestation’. This name is given to a child who is expected to have a strong focus and dedication towards their goals.
